title: AI ki Asli Buniyaad aur Misaalein
subtitle: Bina kisi math ke samjhein ke AI normal coding se alag kaise hai.

hero.heading: Arey Yaaron, AI Bole to Asal mein kya hai?
hero.intro: AI yaane Artificial Intelligence bole to computer'aa ko dimaag dena. Iska matlab ye nahi hai ki computer khud ba khud sochra. Khali usko bohot saara data (jaise photo’aa, likhe so baataan) dikha ke seekha dete. Uske baad, computer naye cheezon ko pehchanta aur jawaab deta, bilkul ek dimaag wale ke jaisa! Asal mein ye khali ek tool hai jo bade data mein se patterns dhoond leta hai.

analogy.label: Ekdam Simple Misaal
analogy.text: Arey bhai, ye bilkul bache ko billi ya kutte ki pehchaan seekhane ke jaisa hai. Tum usko kitaab padha ke biological details nahi samjhate. Tum usko hazaaro baar kutte dikhaate. Bache ka dimaag khud-ba-khud floppy ears, moochh aur dum ke patterns jod leta hai. Bas, computer bhi aise hi seekhta hai!

patternMatcher.title: Pattern Pehchanne Wala
patternMatcher.subtitle: Pehle data andar jaata, phir patterns dhoond ke, seedha faisla bahar aata!

pocketExamples.title: Roz ka AI Istemaal
pocketExamples.subtitle: Hum roz bohot saari jagah pattern matching dekhte hain aur humein pata bhi nahi chalta yaaron. Dekho ye 6 asaan misalein.
pocketExamples.hint: Koyi bhi card dabaake check karo iske piche kya logic hai.

items.title: Netflix ki Soch
items.explanation: Blindly select karne ke bajaye, ye tumhari watched films ko baaqi hazaaro logon se compare karke dhang ke patterns nikalta hai.

items.title: Google Maps ETA
items.explanation: Purani traffic congestion aur abhi chalre so gaadiyon ki speed dekh ke bilkul minute to minute sahi rasta aur ETA batata hai.

items.title: ChatGPT ke Jawaab
items.explanation: Aisa program jisko duniya jahan ki kitabein padhaye, taaki wo sentence mein agla sabse logical word khud predict kar sake.

items.title: Awaaz wale Assistants
items.explanation: Hamari boli so awaaz ko text commands mein badal ke mobile ya speaker ko alarm lagane ya gaana bajane bolta hai.

items.title: Spam Filter (Safe Inbox)
items.explanation: Har aane wale mail ko scan karta hai warning words aur fake senders ke liye, taaki kachra mail seedha spam folder mein chale jaye.

items.title: Chehra Pehchanna
items.explanation: Chehre ki ankhon, naak, aur naksh ko pehchan ke ek hi dost ki saari photos ko ek album mein jama kar deta hai.

threeHorizons.title: AI ke Teen Horizons
threeHorizons.subtitle: Duniya ke bade scientists AI ko teen bade darjon mein divide karte hain machines ki taaqat ke mutabiq.

items.title: Narrow AI (Chota AI)
items.description: Aise systems jo khali ek hi kaam mein ustad hote hain, jaise chess khelna ya gaane batana. Aaj chalra so har AI khali ANI hai yaaron.

items.title: General AI (Insaan ke Jaisa)
items.description: Insaan ke barabar dimaag rakhne wala AI jo koi bhi naya kaam khud seekh sake. Ye abhi tak nahi bana hai yaaron.

items.title: Super AI (Insaan se aage)
items.description: Aisi machine jo har cheez mein insaani dimaag se hazar guna aage nikal jaye. Khali filmon mein dikhate abhi tak.
